rows.topic: Evidence-grounded revision of responses to scientific peer reviewers
Preserving exploratory claims in cross-disciplinary research proposals

secondary: ai+mixed and classification; not fraction of AI-written words
attribution: New pipeline changes the rewriting model and adds bounded repairs; no isolated MemGuard or CoPA benefit is established.
limitations: Two additional generated proposals using the same five-source packet; not a representative corpus.
Content and readability audits are automated, not human evaluation.
Baseline and new pipeline have different models and compute costs.
Targeted-only control preserves published Targeted prompts/retention, but reviews only its own candidate batch.
All baseline AI probabilities are at the upper bound of 1; zero losses cannot establish general non-inferiority.
Model generation and external detector versions may change; saved responses reproduce observations, not guarantee fresh scores.
